news.title: Oil surges 35% this week for biggest gain in futures trading history dating back to 1983
news.description: The oil market is worried that Gulf countries will have to shut production if tankers are unable to pass through the Strait of Hormuz.

news.title: Amazon says Anthropic’s Claude still OK for AWS customers to use outside defense work
news.description: Amazon joined Microsoft and Google in continue to offer Anthropic's Claude AI technology to customers after the Pentagon deemed it a "supply chain risk."

news.title: Google joins Microsoft in telling users Anthropic is still available outside defense projects
news.description: Cloud vendors are letting customers know that Anthropic's popular AI tools can still be accessed after the Department of Defense blacklisted the company.
